currentSource: Save the current adversarial settings to this server.
proposedSource: Save the current privacy and anonymity settings to this server.
rationale: The caller is in AdversarialSettings.jsx; its section describes advanced privacy and anonymity features and covers Tor/anonymity configuration. The old English adversarial label induces false-friend translations (opposition/hostility). Reword the source to describe the settings actually saved.

translations.ar: احفظ إعدادات الخصوصية وإخفاء الهوية الحالية على هذا الخادم.
translations.de: Speichern Sie die aktuellen Datenschutz- und Anonymitätseinstellungen auf diesem Server.
translations.es: Guarde la configuración actual de privacidad y anonimato en este servidor.
translations.fr: Enregistrez les paramètres actuels de confidentialité et d’anonymat sur ce serveur.
translations.hi: वर्तमान गोपनीयता और गुमनामी सेटिंग्स इस सर्वर पर सहेजें।
translations.id: Simpan pengaturan privasi dan anonimitas saat ini ke server ini.
translations.ja: 現在のプライバシー設定と匿名性の設定をこのサーバーに保存します。
translations.ko: 현재 개인정보 보호 및 익명성 설정을 이 서버에 저장합니다.
translations.pt-BR: Salve as configurações atuais de privacidade e anonimato neste servidor.
translations.vi: Lưu các cài đặt quyền riêng tư và ẩn danh hiện tại lên máy chủ này.
translations.zh-Hans: 将当前隐私和匿名设置保存到此服务器。
translations.zh-Hant: 將目前的隱私與匿名設定儲存到此伺服器。

proposedSource: Close the window showing the contents of the selected share.
rationale: ContentsModal displays the selected share's path contents. Existing translations frequently parse share contents as the action of sharing content. This wording identifies the window as showing the contents belonging to a share.

translations.ar: أغلق النافذة التي تعرض محتويات المجلد المشترك المحدد.
translations.de: Schließen Sie das Fenster, das den Inhalt der ausgewählten Freigabe anzeigt.
translations.es: Cierra la ventana que muestra el contenido del recurso compartido seleccionado.
translations.fr: Fermez la fenêtre qui affiche le contenu du partage sélectionné.
translations.hi: चुने गए साझा फ़ोल्डर की सामग्री दिखाने वाली विंडो बंद करें।
translations.id: Tutup jendela yang menampilkan isi folder bersama yang dipilih.
translations.ja: 選択した共有フォルダーの内容を表示するウィンドウを閉じます。
translations.ko: 선택한 공유 폴더의 내용을 표시하는 창을 닫습니다.
translations.pt-BR: Feche a janela que mostra o conteúdo da pasta compartilhada selecionada.
translations.vi: Đóng cửa sổ hiển thị nội dung của thư mục được chia sẻ đã chọn.
translations.zh-Hans: 关闭显示所选共享文件夹内容的窗口。
translations.zh-Hant: 關閉顯示所選共享資料夾內容的視窗。
